GM12878: parameter choices on real assemblies

This notebook supports the Results section “Parameter choices on real assemblies” (../manuscript/sections/results_gm12878_parameters.tex, sec:parameters) and Fig. 7 (fig:parameters, caption in figures_main.tex). It draws Fig. 7 (figures/fig7_parameters.{pdf,png}) and computes the numbers the section quotes. Provenance: E13 (start-parameter grid), E04 (minimum length), E20 and E22 (q-value test, development runs), E06 (homology series; release rerun with PyTD a5b24c3) and E25 (release runs).

Which runs. The release runs (E25: PyTD 3a793ff; q-value test at q 0.05, 50-codon minimum, start refinement alpha 0.4, Kozak 17 per bit) are used where an equivalent exists or could be derived:

  • Fig. 7b (post-hoc minimum length) and the minimum-length paragraph: release ab initio predictions, re-evaluated with --min-aa (pipeline/derive/08_minaa_sweep_final_v7.sh).
  • Fig. 7b markers: the three q settings of the release (--precise, default, --sensitive). These replace the earlier markers (pre-defined LongOrfs minimum runs from development code), as the caption’s \todo asks.
  • The q-value paragraph: release protein matches and a release version of the dropped-ORF support table (pipeline/derive/08_rule_support_v7.py).
  • The homology series (Fig. 7c, d) and the transposable-element paragraph: release rerun with PyTD a5b24c3 (homology-assisted start refinement on; pipeline/derive/08_homology_series_v7h.sh, E06 “Release rerun”). The development series (48c870c) is tabulated for comparison.

No release equivalent exists for:

  • the start-parameter grid (Fig. 7a; development code 48c870c, E13). Fig. 7a adds the release default as one extra point per assembly;
  • the comparison of pre-defined LongOrfs minima (-m 100, -m 50 without a test; E04).

These use the data of the earlier figure.

ASM <- c("lraa", "stringtie", "trinity")
SHORT <- c(lraa = "LRAA", stringtie = "StringTie", trinity = "Trinity")
asm_factor <- function(x) factor(x, levels = ASM, labels = ASM_LABEL[ASM])

# key/value eval summaries (eval_genome_cds.py)
kv <- function(...) {
  x <- readr::read_tsv(data_path(...), col_names = c("key", "value"), show_col_types = FALSE,
                       col_types = "cc")
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x$value)); names(v) <- x$key; v
}
rel_eval <- function(asm, setting = "default") {
  suf <- if (setting == "default") "" else paste0("_", setting)
  kv("benchmark", "final_v7", sprintf("eval.%s_final_v7_abinitio%s.summary.tsv", asm, suf))
}

grid <- read_tab("start_param_sensitivity", "gm12878.tsv")
start_share <- read_tab("gm12878", "final_v7", "08_start_share.tsv") %>%
  mutate(share = complete_gencode_exact / complete_gencode_compatible)
sweep_v7 <- read_tab("gm12878", "final_v7", "08_minaa_sweep_v7.tsv")
sweep_dev <- readr::read_tsv(data_path("gm12878", "gm12878_minaa_sweep.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_names = c("assembly", "min_aa", "distinct_predicted_cds", "MANE_sens_exact",
                "MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled", "GENCODE_complete_sens_compatible",
                "pred_all_GENCODE_exact_frac", "pred_all_GENCODE_compatible_frac",
                "pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac", "pred_complete_GENCODE_exact_frac"))
by_len <- read_tab("gm12878", "final_v7", "08_no_overlap_by_length.tsv") %>%
  mutate(frac = no_gencode_cds_overlap / n)
pm_v7 <- read_tab("benchmark", "final_v7", "gm12878_v7_protein_matches.tsv") %>%
  separate(label, c("assembly", "setting"), sep = "\\.v7_")

hom_dev <- read_tab("gm12878", "gm12878_homology_series.tsv")
ret_txt <- readLines(data_path("gm12878", "gm12878_homology_primate_retention_v7h.txt"))
ret_txt_dev <- readLines(data_path("gm12878", "gm12878_homology_primate_retention.txt"))
te_screen <- read_tab("gm12878", "gm12878_te_screen_v7h.tsv")

Start refinement

Source: data/start_param_sensitivity/gm12878.tsv (E13; development code 48c870c, identical to the earlier final_abinitio runs at alpha 0.4, w 25 per nat). The grid weight is per nat; 25 per nat is 17.3 per bit, and the shipped 17 per bit differs by rounding only (E13 addendum). The grid was run on LRAA and StringTie only. Rows: no refinement (norefine), the default (a0.4_w25), the default without the Kozak term (a0.4_w0) and alpha 1.0 (a1.0_w25).

g <- function(a, cfg, col) grid[[col]][grid$assembly == a & grid$config == cfg]
start_tab <- grid %>% filter(config %in% c("norefine", "a0.4_w0", "a0.4_w25", "a1.0_w25")) %>%
  transmute(assembly, config, `MANE exact given assembled` = MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled,
            `complete, GENCODE exact` = pred_complete_gencode_exact,
            `complete, compatible not exact` = pred_complete_compatible_not_exact,
            `5'-partial` = distinct_predicted_5prime_partial,
            `exact-start share` = pred_complete_start_precision)
kable(start_tab)

  • Exact complete calls: 9,309 to 13,805 and 7,562 to 12,018. 5’-partial calls: 10,544 to 3,030 and 10,693 to 2,631.
  • Exact-start share of GENCODE-compatible complete calls: 73.3% to 78.4% and 81.7% to 84.3%.
  • Wrong-start complete calls (compatible, not exact): 3,396 to 3,796 and 1,697 to 2,231.
  • Kozak term (w 25 vs 0 at alpha 0.4): 3.1 and 2.8 points of MANE exact recovery; 0.7 and 1.1 points of exact-start share.
  • alpha 0.4 to 1.0: MANE exact given assembled StringTie 92.7% to 94.9%, LRAA 93.5% to 95.5%; wrong-start complete calls 4,239 and 2,817; exact-start share 77.0% and 81.5%.

Release runs (E25; q-value test, w 17 per bit). The exact-start share is computed in the same way from the release pred_status tables (08_start_share.tsv; the earlier final_abinitio rows reproduce the grid’s default cell exactly):

                                 g("stringtie", "a0.4_w25", "pred_complete_start_precision"))) < 1e-4)))

Release default: MANE exact given assembled LRAA 92.9%, StringTie 91.5%, Trinity 89.3%; exact-start share 84.8%, 79.0%, 58.7%. The q-value test removes some complete calls, which raises the share slightly and lowers MANE exact recovery (E25). The text’s start-refinement numbers are from the grid and stay valid as a description of the refinement step; the default point in Fig. 7a differs from the release by the ORF acceptance rule.

E13, E09, E25

Minimum length and the q-value cutoff

A 50-codon minimum without a test (development runs)

Runs with a pre-defined LongOrfs minimum and no short-ORF test exist only from development code (E04: m50, and kozak_add = -m 100; data/gm12878/eval_summaries/). There is no release equivalent.

dev_sum <- function(a, cfg) kv("gm12878", "eval_summaries", sprintf("%s_%s.summary.tsv", a, cfg))
m50_tab <- expand_grid(assembly = c("lraa", "stringtie"),
                       config = c("kozak_add", "m50", "m50_sc200")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(run = c(kozak_add = "-m 100", m50 = "-m 50, no test",
                 m50_sc200 = "-m 50 + fixed short-ORF test")[config],
         distinct_cds = dev_sum(assembly, config)[["distinct_predicted_cds"]],
         MANE_exact_given_assembled = dev_sum(assembly, config)[["MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"]],
         no_GENCODE_overlap = dev_sum(assembly, config)[["pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"]]) %>%
  ungroup()
kable(m50_tab)

No GENCODE CDS overlap, -m 100 to -m 50 without a test: LRAA 3.5% to 10.7%, StringTie 11.8% to 34.7%. For comparison, the release default gives 1.5% (LRAA), 5.5% (StringTie) and 4.2% (Trinity) (E25).

E04, E25

Matching and non-matching proteins by q setting

Predicted proteins identical to, or sharing an exact 30-residue window with, a GENCODE v50 protein are “matching”; the rest are “non-matching” (score_protein_matches.py). Release runs: data/benchmark/final_v7/gm12878_v7_protein_matches.tsv (E25). The development runs quoted in the current text (E22) and the fixed short-ORF test (cliff_c200) are in data/benchmark/qmodes/gm12878_qmodes_protein_matches.tsv.

SETTING <- c(precise = "q 0.01 (--precise)", default = "q 0.05 (default)",
             sensitive = "q 0.2 (--sensitive)")
dev_map <- c(precise = "decoy_q0.01_longgc", default = "decoy_q0.05_longgc",
             sensitive = "decoy_q0.2_longgc")
q_tab <- pm_v7 %>% select(assembly, setting, matching = true_positives, nonmatching) %>%
  left_join(pm_dev %>% filter(setting %in% dev_map) %>%
              mutate(setting = names(dev_map)[match(setting, dev_map)]) %>%
              select(assembly, setting, dev_matching = true_positives, dev_nonmatching = nonmatching),
            by = c("assembly", "setting")) %>%
  mutate(no_GENCODE_overlap = mapply(function(a, s) rel_eval(a, s)[["pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"]],
                                     assembly, setting),
         MANE_exact_given_assembled = mapply(function(a, s) rel_eval(a, s)[["MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"]],
                                             assembly, setting),
         catalog_riboseq_orfs = cat_v7$stop_match[match(
           paste0(assembly, "_final_v7_abinitio", ifelse(setting == "default", "", paste0("_", setting))),
           cat_v7$run)])
cliff <- pm_dev %>% filter(setting == "cliff_c200") %>% select(assembly, matching = true_positives, nonmatching)
kable(q_tab %>% mutate(setting = SETTING[setting]))

Release runs, matching / non-matching (LRAA; StringTie):

  • default q 0.05: 32,751 / 277; 35,294 / 1,185. Trinity: 78,181 / 2,616.
  • fixed short-ORF test (development): 33,587 / 1,005; 36,547 / 4,119.
  • q 0.01: 31,672 / 189; 33,647 / 698.
  • q 0.2: 33,443 / 560; 36,903 / 2,879.

At the default, non-matching proteins fell 3.6-fold (LRAA) and 3.5-fold (StringTie), for a loss of 2.5% and 3.4% of matching ones (development runs: 3.6 and 3.4-fold, 2.5% and 3.2%). The no-GENCODE-overlap share of release predictions is 1.2% / 1.5% / 2.3% (LRAA; q 0.01 / 0.05 / 0.2) and 4.1% / 5.5% / 9.6% (StringTie). Catalogued Ribo-seq ORFs matched by stop codon fall from 178 / 217 / 455 with the fixed short-ORF test (E04, E25) to 101 / 95 / 186 at the default.

E22, E20, E25

Support of the ORFs that the q-value test removed

The text quotes the release version. An earlier draft quoted gm12878_rule_support.tsv (E20/E22; development run decoy_q0.05, without long-ORF retention, against the development fixed short-ORF run cliff_c200), shown below for comparison. The release version, data/gm12878/final_v7/08_rule_support_v7.tsv (pipeline/derive/08_rule_support_v7.py), compares the release runs with the earlier final_abinitio runs (fixed short-ORF test; their Ribo-seq and MS tables from E01/E02). An ORF is identified by transcript, strand and stop codon. “dropped” are final_abinitio ORFs with no release prediction with that stop; “all” are the release predictions, scored with the release Ribo-seq and MS tables (E25). Ribo-seq rates are over ORFs with at least ten P-sites; MS rates are over all ORFs (gene models).

Release defaults: 5%–19% of predictions shorter than 100 aa or of 100–149 aa have no GENCODE CDS overlap, against 0.4%–1.2% of those of at least 300 aa (earlier runs: 18%–41% and 0.4%–1.2%).

Post-hoc minimum length

eval_genome_cds.py --min-aa L on the release default predictions (data/gm12878/final_v7/08_minaa_sweep_v7.tsv; same procedure as E04, which used the earlier final_abinitio predictions, data/gm12878/gm12878_minaa_sweep.tsv). The filter keeps predictions encoding at least L aa (stop excluded); it is applied after prediction, so training and per-transcript selection still see all candidates.

                                 dev_no_overlap = pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac),
            by = c("assembly", "min_aa"))

Removing release predictions below 150 aa cuts the no-overlap share to 1.0% (LRAA), 3.3% (StringTie) and 2.2% (Trinity), while MANE exact given assembled falls from 0.93, 0.91 and 0.89 (unfiltered) to 0.85, 0.86 and 0.83. Between 50 and 100 aa, MANE exact given assembled changes by -0.016, -0.011, -0.011 and the no-overlap share by -0.2, -1.0, -0.8 points (LRAA, StringTie, Trinity).

E06

Homology to transposable elements retains short unannotated ORFs

Source: data/gm12878/gm12878_homology_primate_retention_v7h.txt (E06 release rerun; homology_series_retention.py, Swiss-Prot minus human vs minus primates, BLAST only). Parsed below; the development values (gm12878_homology_primate_retention.txt) follow.

prot_n <- function(line, prot) {
  m <- regmatches(line, regexec(sprintf("\\('%s', (\\d+)\\)", prot), line))[[1]]
  if (length(m) == 2) as.integer(m[2]) else 0L
}
parse_ret <- function(asm, txt = ret_txt) {
  i <- which(txt == paste("==", asm))
  blk <- txt[(i + 1):(i + 4)]
  n_only <- as.integer(sub("in A only: (\\d+) .*", "\\1", blk[1]))
  novel <- as.integer(sub(".*'novel': (\\d+).*", "\\1", blk[1]))
  short <- as.integer(sub(".*short\\(<100aa\\): (\\d+).*", "\\1", blk[1]))
  tibble(assembly = asm, only_minus_human = n_only, unannotated = novel, short_lt100 = short,
         best_hit_UTY_PANTR = prot_n(blk[3], "UTY_PANTR"), best_hit_LIN1_NYCCO = prot_n(blk[3], "LIN1_NYCCO"),
         best_hit_LORF2_MOUSE = prot_n(blk[3], "LORF2_MOUSE"))
}
ret <- bind_rows(parse_ret("trinity"), parse_ret("stringtie"), parse_ret("lraa"))
ret_dev <- bind_rows(parse_ret("trinity", ret_txt_dev), parse_ret("stringtie", ret_txt_dev))
kable(ret, caption = "Release (a5b24c3)")

Figure 7

Port of figures/fig7_parameters/make_fig7.py, with two changes, both to use the release runs:

    1. The release default (q-value test, w 17 per bit) is added as a cross per assembly; the grid is unchanged.
  • (b) Lines are the post-hoc filter on the release predictions. Markers are the release q settings at the 50-codon minimum: q 0.01, q 0.05 (default) and q 0.2 (drawn at 45, 50 and 55 aa so they do not overlap). They replace the earlier pre-defined-minimum runs from development code. Trinity was run at the default only.

Panels c and d use the release homology series (PyTD a5b24c3; E06 release rerun); they replace the development series (48c870c).

# (a) start refinement
pa_dat <- grid %>% filter(assembly %in% c("lraa", "stringtie"), config != "norefine", weight %in% c(0, 25)) %>%
  mutate(w = ifelse(weight == 25, "w = 17/bit", "w = 0"))
pa_lab <- pa_dat %>% filter(weight == 25, alpha %in% c(0.2, 1.0)) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("α = ", alpha))
pa_def <- pa_dat %>% filter(weight == 25, alpha == 0.4)
pa_rel <- rel_start %>% filter(assembly != "trinity")
pa <- ggplot(pa_dat, aes(MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled, pred_complete_start_precision,
                         colour = assembly, group = interaction(assembly, w))) +
  geom_path(aes(linetype = w), linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = w), size = 1.1, fill = "white", stroke = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = pa_def, aes(group = NULL), shape = 21, size = 3, colour = "black", stroke = 0.35) +
  geom_point(data = pa_rel, aes(mane, share, group = NULL), shape = 4, size = 1.8, stroke = 0.6,
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = pa_lab, aes(label = label, group = NULL, hjust = ifelse(alpha < 0.5, 1.15, -0.1),
                               vjust = ifelse(alpha < 0.5, 0.5, 1.3)),
            size = 1.95, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ASM_COLOR, labels = ASM_LABEL, guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("w = 17/bit" = "solid", "w = 0" = "22"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("w = 17/bit" = 16, "w = 0" = 21), name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.83, 0.975)) +
  labs(x = "MANE exact given assembled", y = "exact-start share of\ncompatible complete calls",
       title = "Start refinement (α)", caption = "large circle: default (grid);  ×: release, q 0.05") +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 5.5, hjust = 0)) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.02, 0.5), legend.justification = c(0, 0.5),
        legend.key.width = unit(5, "mm"))

# (b) minimum length
QSET <- c(precise = "q 0.01", default = "q 0.05 (default)", sensitive = "q 0.2")
QSHAPE <- c("q 0.01" = 25, "q 0.05 (default)" = 23, "q 0.2" = 24)
pb_lines <- sweep_v7 %>% mutate(assembly = factor(assembly, levels = ASM))
# markers drawn at 45 / 50 / 55 aa so they do not overlap; all three runs use the 50-codon minimum
pb_pts <- q_tab %>% mutate(qs = factor(QSET[setting], levels = QSET),
                           min_aa = c(precise = 45, default = 50, sensitive = 55)[setting],
                           assembly = factor(assembly, levels = ASM))
panel_b <- function(col_line, col_pt, ylab, title, legend = FALSE) {
  ggplot(pb_lines, aes(min_aa, .data[[col_line]], colour = assembly)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 50, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + geom_point(size = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = pb_pts, aes(y = .data[[col_pt]], shape = qs), fill = "white", size = 1.6,
               stroke = 0.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = ASM_COLOR, guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = QSHAPE, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(50, 100, 150, 200, 300)) +
    labs(x = "minimum protein length (aa)", y = ylab, title = title) +
    theme(legend.position = if (legend) "inside" else "none", legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.98), legend.justification = c(1, 1))
}
pb1 <- panel_b("MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled", "MANE_exact_given_assembled",
               "MANE exact given\nassembled", "Minimum length: accuracy")
pb2 <- panel_b("pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac", "no_GENCODE_overlap",

# (c, d) homology
XLEV <- c(paste0("−", CLADES), "Pfam\nonly")
PFAM_X <- 5.6
hom_pl <- hom_d %>% filter(config != "abinitio") %>%
  mutate(taxid = sub("blast_(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", config),
         db = case_when(config == "pfam" ~ "Pfam only",
                        grepl("_nopfam$", config) ~ "Swiss-Prot",
                        TRUE ~ "Swiss-Prot + Pfam"),
         x = ifelse(config == "pfam", "Pfam\nonly", paste0("−", CLADES[taxid])),
         xn = ifelse(config == "pfam", PFAM_X, match(x, XLEV)),
         assembly = factor(assembly, levels = ASM))
panel_cd <- function(col, scale, ylab, title) {
  d <- hom_pl %>% mutate(y = .data[[col]] * scale)
  ggplot(d %>% filter(db != "Pfam only"), aes(xn, y, colour = assembly,
                                               group = interaction(assembly, db))) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_line(aes(linetype = db), linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = db), size = 1.1, fill = "white", stroke = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = d %>% filter(db == "Pfam only"), aes(shape = db, linetype = db), size = 1.4) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = ASM_COLOR, guide = "none") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Swiss-Prot" = "solid", "Swiss-Prot + Pfam" = "22", "Pfam only" = "blank"),
                          breaks = c("Swiss-Prot", "Swiss-Prot + Pfam", "Pfam only"), name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Swiss-Prot" = 16, "Swiss-Prot + Pfam" = 21, "Pfam only" = 18),
                       breaks = c("Swiss-Prot", "Swiss-Prot + Pfam", "Pfam only"), name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1:5, PFAM_X), labels = XLEV, limits = c(0.6, 5.9)) +
    labs(x = "Swiss-Prot with clade removed", y = ylab, title = title) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}

  scale_fill_manual(values = ASM_COLOR, labels = ASM_LABEL, name = NULL) +

get_legend <- function(p) {
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)
  i <- which(grepl("guide-box", sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name)) &
             !sapply(g$grobs, inherits, "zeroGrob"))
  g$grobs[[i[1]]]
}
leg <- patchwork::wrap_elements(full = get_legend(leg))
